entries.title: Your crew looks for the release that work waits on
entries.body: When a task waits for merged work to ship in a release, such as a thank-you to the person who reported an issue, Infinitary now starts a short task, Find the first release of merged work, that looks for that release however your project ships and records it. It runs soon after a new tag appears in your project, at most every few hours, and at least once a day while something waits, and it closes itself. The waiting task then starts.
entries.noPicture: The only trace on screen is one more task in the Tasks list, which starts and closes by itself.
